name: Shadow of Another World
description:
The behemoth that once devoured the birthing waters of the planet has departed without a single trace, but those in the know will forever live, surely, in the terrifying shadow of that omen of the end.
A single shard of shattered spacetime remains in this place, and through it, you may perhaps be able to witness that titanic creature once more.

tabs.name: Memories: The Titan Amidst the Stars I
tabs.description:
The battle against the beast from another world was the intersection point for this world's fate.
Today, Fontaine treads a brighter path.
But the echoing whale-song of the giant will not fade utterly from your mind.
Relive your memories and once again partake in the battle. Maybe you'll learn something new.
